resolved_contract_gaps.title: RG-04 operation registry
resolved_contract_gaps.implemented_change: Implemented the closed RG-04 action registry for manual mixed-expense creation and rejection, credit-principal repayment, mixed-payment source intake, candidate confirmation, and mirror-evidence reconciliation. Accepted and no-change operations use their exact closed input branches, rejected attempts use the sparse closed attempted_input branch, and retries retain the originating action and class with typed returned references.
alternatives: Keep the pre-amendment contract and leave RG-04 expected output blocked.
resolved_contract_gaps.risk: Open or ambiguous operation inputs would weaken dispatch, rejection closure, and idempotent no-change behavior.

resolved_contract_gaps.title: RG-04 source and candidate payloads
resolved_contract_gaps.implemented_change: Implemented complete and missing-funding-leg mixed_payment sources and candidates. Source payloads own observed funding facts; candidate payloads own total, currency, known funding, provenance, evidence references, confirmation requirements, and deterministic status_history records.
alternatives: Keep the pre-amendment contract and leave RG-04 expected output blocked.
resolved_contract_gaps.risk: Misplacing source facts, candidate provenance, or status history would permit guessed funding, lose auditability, or imply confirmation before the user acts.

resolved_contract_gaps.title: RG-04 posting roles
resolved_contract_gaps.implemented_change: Implemented the four RG-04 posting roles mixed_expense_asset_funding, mixed_expense_credit_funding, credit_repayment_asset_outflow, and credit_repayment_liability_principal so funding and principal repayment remain distinct from consumption.
alternatives: Keep the pre-amendment contract and leave RG-04 expected output blocked.
resolved_contract_gaps.risk: Generic funding roles could count liability financing or principal repayment as consumption and corrupt cash-flow attribution.

resolved_contract_gaps.title: RG-04 mixed_payment relation
resolved_contract_gaps.implemented_change: Implemented the closed mixed_payment relation with separate id and type, exactly one transaction member and two posting members, and a system-managed payload whose funding components reuse the existing posting identities without creating another economic event.
alternatives: Keep the pre-amendment contract and leave RG-04 expected output blocked.
resolved_contract_gaps.risk: Independent component identities or an order-like relation could duplicate formal effects or detach funding composition from the actual postings.

resolved_contract_gaps.title: RG-04 financial evidence
resolved_contract_gaps.implemented_change: Implemented source-linked asset_funding_debit and credit_liability_mirror evidence payloads plus typed posting evidence links using target_kind, target_id, and the real_account_posting role; posting reconciliation remains the status owner.
alternatives: Keep the pre-amendment contract and leave RG-04 expected output blocked.
resolved_contract_gaps.risk: Untyped evidence or transaction-level matching could attach a financial record to the wrong posting and make reconciliation alter accounting facts.
